Class Move

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Move
public final class Move extends Object
A requested move: a source square, a destination square, and (for a pawn reaching the last rank) the piece type to promote to.

Instances are immutable, like Position, so the same object can be passed between the GUI, the game, and the computer opponent without anyone changing it. A Move says nothing about whether it is legal; MoveValidator decides that.

  • Constructor Details

    • Move

      public Move(Position from, Position to)
      Creates a move with no promotion choice.
      Parameters:
      from - source square; must not be null
      to - destination square; must not be null

    • Move

      public Move(Position from, Position to, PieceType promotion)
      Creates a move with an optional promotion choice.
      Parameters:
      from - source square; must not be null
      to - destination square; must not be null
      promotion - queen, rook, bishop, or knight; or null for none
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if from or to is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if promotion is a pawn or king
